006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.AbstractAtomicOrUnionType;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
014
015import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryDecoder;
016import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryEncoder;
017import org.apache.commons.codec.DecoderException;
018import org.apache.commons.codec.EncoderException;
019
020import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
021import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
022import java.util.Arrays;
023
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025
026/**
027 * Maintains a byte buffer representation of a byte stream.
028 * <p>
029 * The maintained byte stream is kept in a decoded form.
030 *
031 * @param <ITEM_TYPE>
032 *          the metapath item type supported by the adapter
033 */
034public abstract class AbstractBinaryAdapter<ITEM_TYPE extends IAnyAtomicItem>
035    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer, ITEM_TYPE> {
036
037  /**
038   * Construct a new Java type adapter for a provided class.
039   *
040   * @param itemClass
041   *          the Java type of the Matepath item this adapter supports
042   * @param castExecutor
043   *          the method to call to cast an item to an item based on this type
044   */
045  protected AbstractBinaryAdapter(
046      @NonNull Class<ITEM_TYPE> itemClass,
047      @NonNull AbstractAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM_TYPE> castExecutor) {
048    super(ByteBuffer.class, itemClass, castExecutor);
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Get the binary decoder to use to decode encoded data.
053   *
054   * @return the decoder
055   */
056  @NonNull
057  protected abstract BinaryDecoder getDecoder();
058
059  /**
060   * Get the binary encoder to use to encode data.
061   *
062   * @return the encoder
063   */
064  @NonNull
065  protected abstract BinaryEncoder getEncoder();
066
067  /**
068   * Get the raw bytes, encoded as UTF8, for the provided text string.
069   *
070   * @param text
071   *          the text string to get the bytes for
072   * @return the UTF8 encoded bytes for the text string
073   */
074  @NonNull
075  private static byte[] stringToBytes(@NonNull String text) {
076    return ObjectUtils.notNull(text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Get a text string based on the provided raw bytes, encoded as UTF8.
081   *
082   * @param bytes
083   *          a byte array encoded as UTF8
084   * @return the decoded text string
085   */
086  @NonNull
087  private static String bytesToString(@NonNull byte[] bytes) {
088    return new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
089  }
090
091  private static String elide(@NonNull String text, int length) {
092    return text.length() <= length ? text : text.substring(0, length) + "…";
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Encode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
097   *
098   * @param decodedBytes
099   *          the bytes to encode
100   * @return the encoded bytes
101   * @see #getEncoder()
102   */
103  @NonNull
104  public byte[] encode(@NonNull byte[] decodedBytes) {
105    try {
106      return ObjectUtils.notNull(getEncoder().encode(decodedBytes));
107    } catch (EncoderException ex) {
108      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
109          String.format("unable to encode text '%s'", elide(bytesToString(decodedBytes), 64)),
110          ex);
111    }
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Encode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
116   *
117   * @param decodedBuffer
118   *          a buffer containing the bytes to encode
119   * @return a buffer containing the encoded bytes
120   * @see #getEncoder()
121   */
122  @NonNull
123  public ByteBuffer encodeToByteBuffer(@NonNull ByteBuffer decodedBuffer) {
124    byte[] decodedBytes = bufferToBytes(decodedBuffer, false);
125    return encodeToByteBuffer(decodedBytes);
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Encode the provided string using the encoding supported by this class.
130   * <p>
131   * The provided string is first encoded as a stream of UTF8 bytes.
132   *
133   * @param decodedText
134   *          the string to encode
135   * @return a buffer containing the encoded bytes
136   * @see #getEncoder()
137   */
138  @NonNull
139  public ByteBuffer encodeToByteBuffer(@NonNull String decodedText) {
140    byte[] decodedBytes = stringToBytes(decodedText);
141    return encodeToByteBuffer(decodedBytes);
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Encode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
146   *
147   * @param decodedBytes
148   *          the bytes to encode
149   * @return a buffer containing the encoded bytes
150   * @see #getEncoder()
151   */
152  @NonNull
153  public ByteBuffer encodeToByteBuffer(@NonNull byte[] decodedBytes) {
154    byte[] encodedBytes = encode(decodedBytes);
155    return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(encodedBytes));
156  }
157
158  /**
159   * Decode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
160   *
161   * @param enodedBytes
162   *          the bytes to decode
163   * @return the decoded bytes
164   * @see #getDecoder()
165   */
166  @NonNull
167  public byte[] decode(@NonNull byte[] enodedBytes) {
168    try {
169      return ObjectUtils.notNull(getDecoder().decode(enodedBytes));
170    } catch (DecoderException ex) {
171      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
172          String.format("unable to decode text '%s'", elide(bytesToString(enodedBytes), 64)),
173          ex);
174    }
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Decode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
179   *
180   * @param encodedBuffer
181   *          a buffer containing the the bytes to decode
182   * @return a buffer containing the decoded bytes
183   * @see #getDecoder()
184   */
185  @NonNull
186  public ByteBuffer decode(@NonNull ByteBuffer encodedBuffer) {
187    byte[] encodedBytes = bufferToBytes(encodedBuffer, false);
188    byte[] decodedBytes = decode(encodedBytes);
189    return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(decodedBytes));
190  }
191
192  /**
193   * Decode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
194   * <p>
195   * The decoded bytes are decoded as a stream of UTF8 bytes to produce the
196   * string.
197   *
198   * @param encodedBytes
199   *          the bytes to decode
200   * @return the decoded string
201   * @see #getDecoder()
202   */
203  @NonNull
204  public String decodeToString(@NonNull byte[] encodedBytes) {
205    byte[] decodedBytes = decode(encodedBytes);
206    return bytesToString(decodedBytes);
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * Decodes the provided string.
211   *
212   * @return a buffer containing the decoded bytes
213   */
214  @Override
215  public ByteBuffer parse(String encodedString) {
216    byte[] encodedBytes = stringToBytes(encodedString);
217    // byte[] decodedBytes = decode(encodedBytes);
218    // return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(decodedBytes));
219    return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(encodedBytes));
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * Get the wrapped value as a base64 encoded string.
224   * <p>
225   * Encodes the wrapped value to produce a string.
226   *
227   * @return the base64 encoded value
228   */
229  @Override
230  public String asString(Object encodedBuffer) {
231    byte[] encodedBytes = bufferToBytes((ByteBuffer) encodedBuffer, false);
232    return new String(encodedBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
233    // return bytesToString(encodedBytes);
234
235    // byte[] decodedBytes = bufferToBytes((ByteBuffer) decodedBuffer, false);
236    // byte[] encodedBytes = encode(decodedBytes);
237    // return bytesToString(encodedBytes);
238  }
239
240  @Override
241  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
242    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
243  }
244
245  @Override
246  public ByteBuffer copy(Object obj) {
247    ByteBuffer buffer = (ByteBuffer) obj;
248    ByteBuffer clone = buffer.isDirect()
249        ? ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(buffer.capacity())
250        : ByteBuffer.allocate(buffer.capacity());
251    ByteBuffer readOnlyCopy = buffer.asReadOnlyBuffer();
252    readOnlyCopy.flip();
253    clone.put(readOnlyCopy);
254    return clone;
255  }
256
257  /**
258   * Get the array of bytes stored in the buffer.
259   *
260   * @param buffer
261   *          the buffer
262   * @param copy
263   *          if {@code true} ensure the resulting array is a copy
264   * @return the array of bytes
265   */
266  @NonNull
267  public static byte[] bufferToBytes(@NonNull ByteBuffer buffer, boolean copy) {
268    byte[] array;
269    if (buffer.hasArray()) {
270      array = buffer.array();
271      if (copy) {
272        array = Arrays.copyOf(array, array.length);
273      }
274    } else {
275      // Handle direct buffers
276      array = new byte[buffer.remaining()];
277      buffer.mark();
278      try {
279        buffer.get(array);
280      } finally {
281        buffer.reset();
282      }
283    }
284    return ObjectUtils.notNull(array);
285  }
286}
